Coram : R.K. AGRAWAL*, R. BANUMATHI
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: ss. 31(5) and 34 – Arbitration award – Petition by appellant No. 1 u/s. 34 for setting aside the award, filed – Award set aside by District Judge for non-compliance of s. 31(5) – High u/s. 34 was time barred and hence was dismissed – On appeal, held: Facts and circumstances of the case show that appellant No. 1 was authorized by his family members to receive a copy of the award and act on their behalf – Service of arbitral award on appellant No. 1 amounts to
